==About==

A {{i|Boiled Gourd}} is made by boiling a {{i|New World Gourd}} in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}}. It is recommended that you use a New World Gourd that is on its last use when making a Boiled Gourd.
